reviews.title: Perfect for all Lifestyles
reviews.text: Honestly, I used to just follow workouts from Anna here and there on YouTube, but her app makes working out so much more convenient and easy to plan. Secondly, many of us are working or in school or have families we are running (all of the above or more than one thing at a time), and the Grow app gives you the freedom to plan and incorporate workouts (or skip until you are able to make the time) without feeling guilty. The layout is intuitive, the workouts are amazing, the plans are simple with the added benefit of you being able to coordinate with your chosen goals… it’s honestly one of the best apps I’ve used. 10/10

reviews.title: Moving My Body with Intention
reviews.text:
Started by following Anna’s YouTube videos and thought those workouts were great! Decided to give the app a go since there’s recipes along with a much bigger range of workouts! Feeling so strong after just 4-6 weeks, and I feel so good being on my feet for work, outings—anything! Love that just 20-45 minutes 4-5 times a week keeps me feeling like my best self 🥰 Thank you for this amazing app and these killer workouts!

UPDATE: I’ve been using this app for almost 3 years now and while I can sometimes fall out of routine, when I’m ready to come back, workouts with Anna are all I can think about. I’ve been finding higher energy levels in the summer, and I love that I can choose to ease my way back in with beginner workouts, or go right into a killer workout! This app is so amazing—thank you Anna for creating a beautiful community where we can keep coming back to feel like our strongest selves 🤍

reviews.title: GREAT
reviews.text:
I really needed a schedule, something to stick to that allows me the flexibility needed to live my life. GROW is everything and more. I had the progress trackers and the meal plans, and you could switch out workouts if you didn’t have the right. I have it for 
a year and it removes the choice that held me back. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Great at first
reviews.text: I have been following Anna for years. I started on her YouTube channel and moved to the app once it launched. At first I loved it. Lately there has not been really many new videos posted and I feel like I have to do the same work outs over and over again. Some of her newer content is much shorter workouts than her usual workouts which is frustrating. I feel like more videos are posted on her YouTube channel that should also be on the app (unless they are and I am just not seeing them). I feel if I am paying a monthly fee I should have access to all videos on the app that I am regularly tracking my progress on. Also why pay when I can just see them for free? Otherwise I love the app and have no issues with it.

reviews.title: Not quite worth it
reviews.text:
I love Anna and her workouts, but this app just didn’t meet my needs. 

The app is beautifully designed but some limitations made it unusable for me. You can’t filter workouts or programs by fitness level, equipment or duration. You can’t retake the custom plan quiz. You can’t view what exact equipment is required on workouts marked as requiring equipment. 

I also found it worked really poorly with AirPlay and screencast was not available. Several times in the middle of a workout it jumped to the cooldown and I had to restart a few times to get back to the main workout, then scrub to where I left off.

For me, just searching Anna’s YouTube channel works best.

reviews.title: Best workout app I’ve ever used
reviews.text: Hands down the best workout app I’ve ever used. Incredible value for the money - and this app is really low priced compared to others, most of which aren’t as good. I’ve seen some serious results in just six weeks - these programs and the individual workout videos have transformed my home workouts. Plus the recipes are actually good! And I love making them for my kids too. My son is allergic to flour and he and my daughter are eating up the protein pancakes (made with oat flour). (Anna, have you considered adding a cookbook to your resume?) If you want to get strong, smash your goals, and improve your long term health, this app is 100% for you.

reviews.title: Helping me reach my goals
reviews.text: This app is helping me reach my fitness goals through variation. It is easy to find a workout that suits my time and type needs. I live in an upstairs apartment and can’t make too much noise because I have to workout at 5am. There are plenty of “no jump” workouts that are still challenging.

reviews.title: Amazingly effective workouts!

reviews.title: Before I buy - temporary rating
reviews.text: Hi! I’ve been following your YouTube workouts for years now but I would really love to commit to the app and have a bit more structure. As a broke college student, I need a bit more exposure what I’d be getting once I have the app. I watched the video “tour” but it’s not much of a tour. I feel a screen recording with a voice over of the app itself would be way more helpful and persuasive in pushing me to make the purchase. If I pay, can I watch the workout videos from more than just my phone? What does the tracking look like/how does it work? What do the plan structures look like and their flexibility? I need a visual rather than a run down. Thank you!

reviews.title: Love the positivity!!
reviews.text: I originally found Grow with Anna on YouTube and I loved all of the videos!  Anna’s positive attitude and strength motivated me to get moving and I finally bought the app and I’m so glad I did!  There are so many awesome workout plans which keep me on track and help me avoid debating forever over which video to do for my morning workout.  The music is also great - I never thought I could work out from home because in the past I didn’t find home workouts challenging and I couldn’t stay motivated.  I’ve been working out with Anna for the last year though and still going strong!  Always challenged, motivated, and inspired!  Thank you Anna!

reviews.title: Anna is the BEST!!
reviews.text:
I found Anna on YouTube one day when I wasn’t feeling very motivated to work out. I did one random video and I’ve been hooked since then!! I’ve been inconsistent with working out for many years but after I found Anna’s YouTube videos I have been working out with her AT LEAST once a day for almost 2 months. The videos on YouTube are free, but after about a month I decided these workouts were worth something and I downloaded the paid app. I haven’t explored all the features of the app, but I love the workout tracking and the fact that I can cast to my TV or take it on the go. 

I love that she doesn’t talk at all during the workouts. Just the music (which is fantastic btw). I used another paid trainer app for a couple years on and off and the instructor talked a lot, as if she was talking to beginners the whole time. That’s great if you’re a beginner but I constantly found myself annoyed, thinking “just get to it already”. I definitely don’t want to be annoyed or have a negative mindset during my workouts.

This app is a game changer for me! I’ll be finishing one of the 28 day challenges this week and starting her 75 hard challenge and I couldn’t be more excited!!

reviews.title: Pros, cons, suggestions
reviews.text:
Pros: 
I love the simplicity of this app. I like that it offers various 30min programs. I love that you can pause your program to start a new one allowing you to go back and pick up where you left off. I love the stretching, recovery, yoga. Love the music option that allows me to set my own. 
Cons: 
I cannot handle all the jumping/high impact. I modify often. Additionally I don’t like the mix of 40min workouts with the 25-30min programs. Lastly, I think 20min abs/core is too long/intense and boring. I hope ab-day gets spread out into the other workouts and not set as its own workout day. 
Improvements: 
It would be nice if I could add workouts to my 3Xweek program, so that it’ll keep track of additional workouts, as apposed to right now only the 3 day workouts from the program are recorded. Also, there’s no history record for programs completed. Maybe a Trophy section can be added to the “Progress” section every time a program is completed. Lastly, moving forward I hope she adds warmups to ALL of the 25-30min workouts.
